mutation.note: All five are in WriteChaseList. The dictionary is only a set of supplier names read by KEYS, so DICT_ADD mode=keep -> overwrite and its value 1 -> 2 change nothing that is read. With the SKIP_IF on a blank Supplier deleted, a Check row with no supplier (certs_01 has one) adds the key "", which is written as an empty cell that the SORT puts last, beyond the used range. LET(outRow, 2 -> 3) and LET(outRow, outRow + 1 -> + 2) only leave blank gap rows that the same SORT moves below the names
